title: When the Universe Hides the Truth
topic: Deep Space Terrors: Rogue black holes drifting silently across galaxies
script: Imagine being the last person on Earth, surrounded by an endless silence. The stars have died, the planets have frozen, and you're left with only one question: what happened? Drifting silently across the galaxy, a rogue black hole has been hiding in plain sight. Its presence warps space-time, creating an illusion of safety. But as you approach the event horizon, the gravity becomes irresistible. Time appears to slow down, and the universe unravels before your eyes. Will you find answers, or will you become a permanent resident of the void? Can you escape the black hole's infinite loop, or will you be trapped forever?
